v10.authorityInvariant: No prompt, model response, webpage, email, issue, comment, analytics event, imported skill, MCP result, workflow payload, provider output, or executor response may increase its own authority.
v10.routingInvariant: Founder Control Room and n8n must validate a Chief AI capability plan and must not reconstruct capability selection from conveyor stage, provider, prompt, or model guess.
v10.learningInvariant: Verified outcomes may create a candidate capability improvement, but analytics and capabilities may not silently rewrite constitutional or founder-native policy or self-promote authority.

browserReality.chiefRole: interpret and summarize rendered evidence without granting authority
browserReality.controlRoomRole: govern evidence status, provider boundaries, continuity, and receipts
browserReality.continuityInvariant: Reuse only existing browser-managed first-party sessions in place; never inspect, extract, export, copy, log, alter, or synthesize cookie or storage values; never use probabilistic fingerprinting, fingerprint alteration, or cross-site tracking.

requiredMarkers: Founder Control Room and Chief AI paired evolution
automatedPostingAuthorization: Founder standing approval applies only to posts inside an approved automated publishing class that pass the Public Communication Truth Contract and all required posting controls. Out-of-class or high-consequence communications require fresh founder approval.
postingTruthBoundary: A draft, scheduler acceptance, workflow trigger, or model response does not prove publication. A publication claim requires an observable platform artifact, reconciliation, and recorded evidence.
postingApprovalPolicy: Per-post founder approval is not required for compliant posts inside the approved automated publishing class. Financial commitments, contracts, payments, fundraising terms, legal positions, crisis communications, admissions of liability, political statements, and other high-consequence communications remain outside standing authorization unless separately approved.
accountingDisclaimer: These are internal controls inspired by sound accounting practice and do not represent an external audit or formal GAAP opinion.
driftPolicy: A material change to either repository requires counterpart review. Unresolved mismatch is pair drift and blocks a complete-state claim.
runtimeTruthBoundary: Passing this static contract proves repository policy alignment only. It does not prove deployed or runtime behavior.
